description: This file defines a feature within an ASP.NET Core application that retrieves a list of tags from the database. It contains the Query and QueryHandler classes used to handle the request for fetching tags, using Entity Framework Core for data access, and MediatR for request processing.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: Represents a request for retrieving tags encapsulated with MediatR's IRequest interface, returning a TagsEnvelope.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the Query request by fetching tags from the database context asynchronously and returning them wrapped in a TagsEnvelope object.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the Query to retrieve tags from the database, sorts them by TagId, converts them to a list of strings, and wraps them in a TagsEnvelope.
